name: Promotion campaign alongside concentrated selling by connected holders
description: Coordinated social-media, messaging-group or cold-call promotion of a low-priced instrument coincides with unusual buying volume while a small group of connected holders sells into the rise.
fp: Genuine news, index inclusion or legitimate investor-relations activity can raise interest and volume. Weight the link between promoters and sellers.

sources.text: FATF, Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing in the Securities Sector, 2009
European Union, Regulation (EU) No 596/2014 on market abuse (Market Abuse Regulation), 2014
FATF, Virtual Assets: Red Flag Indicators of Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing, 2020

links.name: Promotion campaign alongside concentrated selling by connected holders
links.ctx: Defines the pump-and-dump pattern and links the promoters to the beneficiaries of the exit trades.
